IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDE MEDICAL, DENTAL, VISION AND LIFE INSURANCE BENEFITS TO PARTICIPATING EMPLOYERS & EMPLOYEES
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE TRUST FUND IS INTENDED TO PROVIDE A DISTINCT LEGAL ENTITY INTO WHICH MONIES MAY BE CONTRIBUTED BY PARTICIPATING EMPLOYERS AND EMPLOYEES FOR THE EXCLUSIVE PURPOSE OF CREATING AND ADMINISTERING AN EMPLOYEE WELFARE BENEFIT PLAN (OR PLANS) FOR THE BENEFIT OF PARTICIPATING EMPLOYERS, AND THEIR BENEFICIARIES, AND FOR DEFRAYING REASONABLE EXPENSES OF ADMINISTRATION.
IRS990.Desc: PROVIDE HEALTH BENEFITS FOR EMPLOYERS/EMPLOYEES AND THEIR COVERED DEPENDENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PLAN MEETS THE REQUIREMENTS FOR QUALIFICATION UNDER SECTION 501(C)(9) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) AND UNDER SECTION 23701(I) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE AND THEREFORE, IS EXEMPT FROM MOST TAXES. THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE HAS DETERMINED AND INFORMED THE PLAN BY A LETTER DATED SEPTEMBER 21, 1990 THAT THE PLAN AND RELATED TRUST ARE DESIGNED IN ACCORDANCE WITH APPLICABLE SECTIONS OF THE IRC. THE PLAN HAS ALSO RECEIVED A DETERMINATION LETTER DATED OCTOBER 17, 2000 FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX BOARD. ALTHOUGH THE PLAN HAS BEEN AMENDED SINCE RECEIVING THE DETERMINATION LETTER, THE PLAN ADMINISTRATOR BELIEVES THAT THE PLAN IS DESIGNED AND IS CURRENTLY BEING OPERATED IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE REQUIREMENTS OF THE IRC AND STATE LAWS. ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES GENERALLY ACCEPTED IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA REQUIRE PLAN MANAGEMENT TO EVALUATE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN BY THE PLAN AND RECOGNIZE A TAX LIABILITY (OR ASSET) IF THE PLAN HAS TAKEN AN UNCERTAIN POSITION THAT MORE LIKELY THAN NOT WOULD NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATIONS BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE. THE PLAN IS SUBJECT TO ROUTINE AUDITS BY TAXING JURISDICTIONS; HOWEVER, THERE ARE CURRENTLY NO AUDITS FOR ANY TAX PERIODS IN PROGRESS.
